name: kwtsms
description: Send SMS through kwtSMS, the Kuwaiti SMS gateway: write the message, fix the numbers, see the cost, and send when you approve. Plus balance, Sender IDs, coverage, message status, and help building SMS and OTP into your app.

username.title: kwtSMS API username
username.description: API username from your kwtSMS account (not your mobile number). Use a dedicated API user for AI tools.

password.title: kwtSMS API password
password.description: API password; kept in secure storage, never shown to the AI.

sender_id.title: Sender ID
sender_id.description: Sender ID used for every send. KWT-SMS is for testing only.

allow_live.title: Allow live sending
allow_live.description: Off: preview and test sends only, nothing reaches a phone. On: real SMS; Claude asks you before each send.

max_numbers.title: Numbers per send
max_numbers.description: Most phone numbers in one send (1 to 200).

max_per_hour.title: Numbers per hour
max_per_hour.description: Most phone numbers sent to in one hour.

max_credits_per_day.title: Credits per day
max_credits_per_day.description: Most credits the plugin may use in one day.

allowed_countries.title: Allowed country codes
allowed_countries.description: Country codes you may send to, comma separated, for example 965 or 965,966,971.
